scope: Full Employee mobile local-prototype audit; no production/native/security/compliance certification
qa_recommendation: NO-GO for full parity/production; GO WITH CONDITIONS for local concept review

issues.title: Calendar status obscures its title at enlarged text
issues.impact: The employee cannot read the complete calendar-link heading at320px/200%.
issues.reproduction: Open page=calendar&appearance=dark at320×844, set200%root text and scroll Your calendar link into view. Not created covers calendar. All three engines reproduce text/status rectangle overlap; the screenshot confirms actual obscured text.
issues.fix: Let the heading and status use nonoverlapping rows or enough minimum width, using existing roles/spacing. Verify longer lifecycle statuses in both themes at200%, then normal320/390/430.
issues.standard: Text resizing/reflow acceptance; WCAG1.4.4/1.4.10 relevance, not a complete WCAG audit.

issues.title: WebKit generic sheets lose exact-opener focus
issues.impact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users lose task context when a pointer-opened sheet closes.
issues.reproduction: Home shift Done/Escape; Schedule shift Done/Escape; Requests New request Escape; More Availability Escape. Independent WebKit run leaves BODY active in all six. Chromium/Firefox return to each exact opener.
issues.fix: Store/focus the actual invoking element for generic sheets; restore it on every close, with a logical fallback if removed. Keep native modal containment and existing special-flow returns.
issues.standard: Project exact-opener requirement and modal-dialog focus pattern; no direct whole-WCAG compliance claim.

issues.title: Closing time off silently discards an edited draft
issues.impact: An accidental Escape forces the employee to enter dates/note again.
issues.reproduction: New request → Nov12–13 → enter note → Escape → reopen. Fields are empty in all engines. Frozen desktop time-off-signature.tsx:17–48 retains an owner-bound unsent draft.
issues.fix: Retain the own-session in-memory draft through dismissal/re-entry or offer a clear keep/discard choice; clear on explicit discard, submission and sign-out. Do not add private browser persistence.
issues.standard: Source parity and error recovery; no invented automatic submission.

issues.title: Notifications highlights More after opening from Home
issues.impact: The active tab disagrees with the entry point and the screen’s Home return.
issues.reproduction: Home → bell. Notifications opens and More is current in all engines. Actual Employee navigation assigns Notifications to Home.
issues.fix: Keep Home current for Notifications, while preserving the alternate More entry and correct contextual returns.
issues.standard: Canonical source navigation ownership and consistent wayfinding.

issues.title: Partial-data warning coexists with immediate review/submission success
issues.impact: Employees cannot tell which information was verified before a consequential sample action.
issues.reproduction: Supported state=partial → Schedule review/confirm or Requests New request/review/submit. All engines reach a success receipt while the refresh warning remains.
issues.fix: Make the unavailable domain explicit and recheck the action’s own current authority/source before proceeding; block only affected actions and provide truthful recovery. Keep unrelated capabilities usable.
issues.standard: Visibility of system state; partial is not proof of revoked permission or a reproduced security bypass.

issues.title: Schedule does not model the complete own-week and revision journey
issues.impact: The prototype cannot demonstrate reviewing republished/removed assignments, earlier weeks or uncertain/conflicting confirmations.
issues.reproduction: Previous is disabled in the initial week; Next stops at the third sample week. Review stores a single current-week boolean. Source supports own past/future weeks and canonical revision-bound recovery.
issues.fix: Build own-week/revision/publication fixtures and contextual shift/open-shift entry points within the current list/detail system. Cover overnight/varied-duration/location data without inventing a Manager filter.
issues.standard: Feature parity, not proof that current matching sample labels or production records are incorrect.

issues.title: Historical timecard decisions are unreachable and state is always Draft
issues.impact: Employees cannot review a populated own historical decision or see a canonical Approved/Finalized/Reopened state in the shipped journey.
issues.reproduction: Hours → Timecards; every route supplies default empty history, and rendered state is a literal Draft. A separate tested history component is not root-app integration.
issues.fix: Supply explicit own fictional timecard state/history to the existing components; preserve read-only Employee snapshots and immutable punches. Do not expose management approval/finalization/export.
issues.standard: Source feature/state parity; empty current sample history alone is not a production data-loss defect.

issues.title: Pay/device-test notices and source-week destinations are missing
issues.impact: Some authorized activity cannot be demonstrated or routed to its exact current source.
issues.reproduction: The model accepts six targets only, omitting PAYROLL_STATEMENT and SELF_TEST. Every schedule target calls setWeek(0), regardless of its source identifier.
issues.fix: Add explicit source-backed own notice fixtures and exact destinations with current capability/source checks. Never invent a Pay notice merely because a document exists; queued test does not mean delivered.
issues.standard: Source-specific notification parity; no generic Employee Mark read.

issues.title: Missing-receipt copy promises legal links below
issues.impact: Small wayfinding mismatch: only Open support and Done appear directly below.
issues.reproduction: Open page=deletion-result without a receipt. Text says Support and legal information are available below; legal reading is reached through Support.
issues.fix: Describe the actual Support destination or expose the existing permitted legal links. No new treatment or legal claim.
issues.standard: Accurate interface copy; independent UI LOW finding.

issues.title: Time-off workplace feature gate is absent from the local model
issues.impact: A future integration could expose time-off entry/actions/attention when that workplace module is off unless the source gate is explicitly carried through.
issues.reproduction: Read model and Request/Home/notice projections: no timeOff capability exists, while source request routes and actions check module/session/proof. No unsupported query parameter is treated as a working off fixture.
issues.fix: Model the independent timeOff capability and its source-consistent menu/read/action/refusal behavior. Availability remains available. Verify current server authorization separately in a future authorized integration environment.
issues.standard: Least privilege and actual source module contract; not a demonstrated server bypass.

scores.band: Good technical foundation; open blocker overrides score
